summary_zh:
西角山，也叫「蝙輻山」，也有人稱作冰島「天空之鏡」，他有多個名稱，西角山以陡峭山峰、黑沙灘與潮濕沙面的倒影聞名，是冰島熱門攝影地點

他其實是「私人景點」，你可以括尋 「Viking Cafe & Guesthouse」，他本身就是簡餐廳、旅館，而這個「山景」，是要付過路費，你才能進入，所以裡面的停車場是「付費 進入」，但外面的…其實也是付費，只是白天老闆比較不會管，晚上就會了。

裡面有兩個停車場，在裡面的「維京人村莊」旁邊有個停車場，可以拍到「天空之鏡」的畫面，另一個停車場比較裡面一點，可以拍出整個「西角山」的整個山形。
summary_en: Vestrahorn (also known as Westfjords Vestrahorn) is a private attraction in the Southeast region of Iceland, famous for its steep peaks, black sand beach, and reflective wet sand. Visitors can access the site via a paid parking fee. There are two parking areas: one near the Viking Cafe & Guesthouse (Viking Village) where you can capture the “sky mirror” reflections, and another slightly farther inside that offers a full view of the mountain’s shape. On‑site facilities include a parking lot (paid), free toilets, a viewing platform, and dining options. It is recommended to allocate about 90 minutes for the visit. Note that while the parking fee is required, enforcement may be less strict during the day.
